message:
docs: record 0.2.134, the Defender false-positive it dodges, and PC2's field update

0.2.133's GNLinkSetup.exe was quarantined by Windows Defender on the company PC (ThreatID
2147731250) so the in-app update could not hash the staged file. The exes are all unsigned, so a
freshly built hash with no reputation gets flagged; a manual download applied Mark-of-the-Web and
triggered the cloud verdict that then stuck to the staged copy too. Defender exclusions were locked
by Tamper Protection on that PC. 0.2.134 is a version-only build whose new hash carries no verdict.

Signed with the operational key and published to the NAS; external https re-download of the Setup
hashes as signed. The company PC then took the in-app update to 0.2.134 (health reached the
directory; NAS reports localVersion=0.2.134). The first attempt failed on the abandon race because
the executing updater was still 0.2.130; the retry succeeded and the machine now runs the fixed
updater.

Task list: V2 closed, V3 reframed, code signing added as C15. History carries the full chain.

제품/테스트/문서: 문서만(이 커밋). 0.2.134 버전 범프는 884d4d6.
